thread.title: Special Participation E: Equation Intuition Annotator
thread.content:
I used Claude’s Artifacts to vibe code an equation annotator to help gain intuition for how often monstrous equations work. I think you need a Claude account to use the actual artifact, but you can replicate this by feeding the same prompt to a chatbot instead of using my tool to send an API request.The link to use it is herehttps://claude.ai/public/artifacts/4a9d7ab1-dbcc-44fc-b0e7-3afe1e45f38dHere is the prompt if you want to use an image of an equation:
I've uploaded an image containing a deep learning equation. Please identify the equation and provide a breakdown with these sections:

1. WHAT IT IS: One sentence describing what this equation represents
2. SYMBOL BREAKDOWN: Explain each symbol/term and what it represents intuitively
3. WHY IT WORKS: Explain the intuition behind why this formulation makes sense
4. WHAT IF WE CHANGE THINGS: For each major variable/parameter, explain what happens when you:
   - Increase it
   - Decrease it
   - Set it to zero (if applicable)
   - Remove it entirely
5. COMMON MISCONCEPTIONS: What do students often get wrong about this?
6. VISUAL INTUITION: Describe a geometric or visual way to think about this

Use LaTeX formatting for any mathematical expressions (use $ for inline math and $ for display math).
Be concise, intuitive, and focus on building understanding rather than just stating facts.

Be concise, intuitive, and focus on building understanding rather than just stating facts.
